name: Paint Your Own Vinyl
label: Hands-on workshop
description:
Scratched, skipped, and officially retired from the turntable, but not from creativity.
Give an old vinyl record a second life as a one-of-a-kind piece of visual art! We'll provide the albums, cleaned up and prepared as ready-to-paint canvases. From bold colors and funky patterns to illustrations and portrait art, you get to decide how to make it your own.
No painting experience is needed. Just your imagination, and willingness to play. And, let's have fun turning something that might have been headed for the curb, into something worthy of your wall.
